name: job-hunter
description: End-to-end job-hunt cold outreach automation. Codex manifest — real logic lives in the framework-agnostic outreach-mcp server; configure via env vars: HUNTER_API_KEY (required), APOLLO_API_KEY, CONTACTOUT_API_KEY, LEMLIST_API_KEY (optional paid), GMAIL_TOKEN_PATH, GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH (Gmail send), LINKEDIN_LI_AT (optional poller). NOTE: the mailapp send channel is macOS-only; Gmail is the only cross-platform send path.
